response.overview: Jacky is a sailor. When his ship stopped at a port, he went with his friends to a nightclub. At this place, Jacky met Urmila, one of the singers at the entertainment venue. They fell in love, but then it was interrupted because Jacky asked a lot about Urmila's past. During a voyage, Jacky's ship was hit by a disaster which resulted in Jacky suffering from a disabled leg. His disability makes him inferior to regain Urmila's love.
response.title: Ombaknya Laut Mabuknya Cinta
